answer: Pay rewards on a slow vesting schedule instead of at once. Each identity's earnings sit in escrow and unlock over ten epochs, and any later fraud finding against that identity, or a cluster it is linked to, claws back everything still locked. A sybil farm then carries a reef of unvested value that one audit can sink, so its risk grows with every fake it runs. Honest agents lose nothing by waiting. Any peer can raise a whisper of suspicion with a small deposit, and a public beacon picks random jurors to review it, so the escrow is always exposed.
